objectives.name: full_result_bound
objectives.semantics: The least proved C in |sum(x_i)| <= C sqrt(sum(x_i^2)) for all real vectors of dimension 100. Partial lemmas have scores=null.

scoring.instructions: This instance accepts partial lemmas only; always return scores=null. Do not infer the complete target bound.

validity.instructions: Check the exact scope of accepted claims. State assumptions and unresolved obligations. A standalone relevant lemma may be valid without proving the full challenge.
